name: New Delhi
scope: Bounded follow-up to find a publisher-supported identity fix or an alternate public Delhi geometry source. No queue/catalog/runtime edits.

identityFinding.viewer: Official e-Dharti Geo Portal labels both Property No and Unique Property ID and offers a layer/attribute/value filter. The full-snapshot audit already documented repeated conflicting geometries for propertyid, unique_propert_id, and their pair; this viewer UI does not introduce another publisher-defined key or cure those collisions.
identityFinding.alternateIdentity: No publisher-supported alternate/composite key found in the bounded official-source inspection.

nativeLanguageSearch.query: दिल्ली राजस्व विभाग खसरा नक्शा GIS भूमि नक्शा साइट revenue.delhi.gov.in
nativeLanguageSearch.assessment: Official Revenue Department result offers district revenue-map downloads; its land-records page describes digitized records and a GIS pilot, not a current parcel feature service. The DLRC home page explicitly links a GIS viewer at gsdl.org.in.

requests.outcome: Official page opened; lists city and district Revenue Map PDFs. These are static map documents, not a machine-readable parcel-feature endpoint; no PDF downloaded.
Official Department of Revenue description says spatial database/georeferenced digital maps were being taken up and mentions a pilot in two villages. No public parcel feature route established.

requests.method: web open; click official “GIS Map See GIS map” link
requests.outcome: DLRC home page opened and links to https://gsdl.org.in/revenue/. Web fetch of the linked GIS URL returned tool error “400 Timeout fetching”; no viewer content or parcel geometry obtained.

Official L&DO viewer page opened and exposes Property No / Unique Property ID search and layer filter UI; this is the previously audited source whose full 25,999-feature snapshot has conflicting duplicate native IDs.

technicalBlocker: Delhi Revenue’s official GIS viewer is linked from DLRC but its gsdl.org.in/revenue/ route timed out on web fetch. Official Revenue Map links are PDFs rather than parcel geometries. L&DO e-Dharti remains a real partial geometry source, but its publisher-visible native ID fields collide with conflicting geometries at full-snapshot scale; no durable identity was found in this bounded follow-up.
nextStep: Keep the existing L&DO source partial and blocked for stable parcel identity. Revisit the official GSDL GIS viewer only if its public route becomes reachable or a publisher documents a disambiguating key.
